text \<open>Rounding: if \<open>2 r q + s = 2 c N + r\<close> with \<open>s < 2 r\<close>, then \<open>q\<close> is within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>.\<close>

lemma div_near:
  assumes eq: "2 * r * q + s = 2 * c * N + r" and hs: "s < 2 * r"
  shows "2 * \<bar>int q * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
proof -
  have hI: "2 * int r * int q + int s = 2 * int c * int N + int r"
    using eq by (simp only: flip: of_nat_mult of_nat_add) (simp)
  have hs0: "(0::int) \<le> int s" by simp
  have hs2: "int s < 2 * int r" using hs by simp
  have hX: "2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N) = int r - int s" using hI by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have "\<bar>2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)\<bar> \<le> int r"
    using hX hs0 hs2 by (simp only: hX) (rule abs_le_iff[THEN iffD2], linarith)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
qed

text \<open>The peak point \<open>j_c = round (c N / r)\<close> lies in range and is within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>.\<close>

lemma peak_point:
  assumes rN: "r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r"
  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
proof -
  have hdm: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
    using Nat.div_add_mod[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: mult.commute)
  show ?thesis
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
    then have hq: "N \<le> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)" by simp
    have h1: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
      using hq by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have h2: "(c + 1) * N \<le> r * N" using cr by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have h3: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) \<le> 2 * c * N + r"
      using hdm by simp
    have h4: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * c * N + r" using h1 h3 by linarith
    have "2 * c * N + 2 * N \<le> 2 * r * N" using h2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    with h4 rN show False by nlinarith
  qed
qed

lemma peak_inj:
  assumes rN: "r < N" and cr: "c < r" and c'r: "c' < r"
    and h1: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
    and h2: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "c = c'"
proof -
  have rN': "int r < int N" using rN by simp
  have r0': "(0::int) \<le> int r" by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN' r0' by linarith
  obtain W where Wdef: "W = int c' - int c" by blast
  have b1: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h1] by simp
  have b2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h2] by simp
  have iden: "2 * (int N * W) = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) - 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N)"
    using Wdef by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hW1: "int N * W \<le> int r" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have hW2: "- int r \<le> int N * W" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have W0: "W = 0"
  proof -
    have "W \<ge> 1 \<or> W \<le> -1 \<or> W = 0" by omega
    then show ?thesis
    proof (elim disjE)
      assume "W \<ge> 1"
      then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * W" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW1 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    next
      assume "W \<le> -1"
      then have "int N * W \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW2 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    qed
  qed
  show ?thesis using W0 Wdef by simp
qed

theorem shor_general_success:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and x0: "x0 < r"
  shows "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
    \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
proof -
  have rN: "r < N" using r rr by nlinarith
  have rPos: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have NPos: "(0::real) < real N" using rN r by simp
  have piPos: "(0::real) < pi" by (rule pi_gt_zero)
  define jc where "jc = (\<lambda>c. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
  define C where "C = {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
  define B where "B = {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}"
  have fC: "finite C" unfolding C_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<r}"]) auto
  have fB: "finite B" unfolding B_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<N}"]) auto
  have peak: "\<And>c. c < r \<Longrightarrow> jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  proof -
    fix c assume cr: "c < r"
    have "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N" using peak_point[OF rN r cr] by simp
    moreover have "2 * \<bar>int ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
    proof -
      have eq: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
        using Nat.div_add_mod[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: mult.commute)
      have hs: "(2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) < 2 * r" using r by (intro Nat.mod_less) auto
      show ?thesis using div_near[OF eq hs] by simp
    qed
    ultimately show "jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      unfolding jc_def by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on jc C"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"
    have cr: "c < r" and cr': "c' < r" using hc hc' unfolding C_def by auto
    have n1: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr] eq by simp
    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp
    show "c = c'" using peak_inj[OF rN cr cr' n1 n2] .
  qed
  have sub: "jc ` C \<subseteq> B"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto
    have cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have rec: "recover N (jc c) = r" using recover_peak[OF rr r cr cop near] .
    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed
  define v where "v = qft N (periodic_state N r x0)"
  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF fB sub]) (simp add: nn)
  have K_le: "\<And>c. c \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> C"
    have cr: "c < r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
        4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c)"
      using shor_peak[OF r rN x0 jlt near] .
    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

text \<open>The peak point \<open>j_c = round (c N / r)\<close> lies in range.\<close>

lemma peak_point:
  fixes r c N :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r"
  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
proof -
  have hdm: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
    using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
  show ?thesis
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
    then have hq: "N \<le> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)" by simp
    have h1: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
      using hq by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have h2: "(c + 1) * N \<le> r * N" using cr by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have h3: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) \<le> 2 * c * N + r"
      using hdm by simp
    have h4: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * c * N + r" using h1 h3 by linarith
    have h5: "2 * c * N + 2 * N \<le> 2 * r * N" using h2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have h6: "2 * r * N = 2 * (r * N)" by simp
    have h7: "2 * c * N = 2 * (c * N)" by simp
    have h8: "2 * r * N = 2 * r * N" by simp
    show False using h4 h5 rN h6 h7 by linarith
  qed
qed

lemma peak_inj:
  fixes r c c' N j :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and cr: "c < r" and c'r: "c' < r"
    and h1: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
    and h2: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "c = c'"
proof -
  have rN': "int r < int N" using rN by simp
  have r0': "(0::int) \<le> int r" by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN' r0' by linarith
  have b1: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h1] by simp
  have b2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h2] by simp
  have iden: "2 * (int N * (int c' - int c)) = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) - 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N)"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hW1: "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int r" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have hW2: "- int r \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have W0: "int c' - int c = 0"
  proof -
    have "int c' - int c \<ge> 1 \<or> int c' - int c \<le> -1 \<or> int c' - int c = 0" by presburger
    then show ?thesis
    proof (elim disjE)
      assume "int c' - int c \<ge> 1"
      then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW1 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    next
      assume "int c' - int c \<le> -1"
      then have "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW2 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    qed

theorem shor_general_success:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and x0: "x0 < r"
  shows "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
    \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
proof -
  have rle: "r \<le> r * r" by (rule le_square)
  have rN: "r < N" using r rr rle by linarith
  have rPos: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have piPos: "(0::real) < pi" by (rule pi_gt_zero)
  define jc where "jc = (\<lambda>c. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
  define C where "C = {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
  define B where "B = {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}"
  have fC: "finite C" unfolding C_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<r}"]) auto
  have fB: "finite B" unfolding B_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<N}"]) auto
  have peak: "\<And>c. c < r \<Longrightarrow> jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"

    fix c assume cr: "c < r"
    have lt: "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N" using peak_point[OF rN r cr] by simp
    have eq: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"

      using div_near[OF eq hs] .
    show "jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      unfolding jc_def using lt near by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on jc C"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"
    have cr: "c < r" and cr': "c' < r" using hc hc' unfolding C_def by auto
    have n1: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr] eq by simp
    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp

  qed
  have sub: "jc ` C \<subseteq> B"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto

    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have rec: "recover N (jc c) = r" using recover_peak[OF rr r cr cop near] .
    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed
  define v where "v = qft N (periodic_state N r x0)"
  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF fB sub]) (simp add: nn)
  have K_le: "\<And>c. c \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> C"
    have cr: "c < r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
        4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c)"
      using shor_peak[OF r rN x0 jlt near] .
    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

  have hb2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)" using hX hs2 by linarith
  have "\<bar>2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)\<bar> \<le> int r"

  then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
